breedtimer.config.title: BreedTimer Settings
breedtimer.config.enabled.desc: Enable or disable the breed timer overlay
breedtimer.config.showAnimals.desc: Track and display breed timers for animals
breedtimer.config.showVillagers.desc: Track and display breed timers for villagers
breedtimer.config.scanRadius.desc: How far the mod looks for animals and eggs. Labels fade out at the distances set below; the scan always covers at least that far.
breedtimer.config.fadeStartDistance.desc: Distance at which floating labels start to fade. Closer than this they draw at full opacity.
breedtimer.config.fadeEndDistance.desc: Distance at which floating labels disappear completely. Kept at or above the fade start, and the scan always reaches at least this far.
breedtimer.config.fovAngle.desc: Not the game's field of view. A label is only drawn for an animal inside a cone of this width around where you are looking. Widen it to label things at the edge of the screen; narrow it to cut the work when a whole herd is on screen.
breedtimer.config.labelLookAtOnly: Label only what you look at
breedtimer.config.labelLookAtOnly.desc: Draws a label only for the animal under your crosshair instead of every animal nearby.
breedtimer.config.labelThroughWalls.desc: On by default. Switch it off to hide a label while terrain stands between you and the animal. Water never counts as blocking.
breedtimer.config.showBabyTimer.desc: Show a growth countdown over baby animals, baby villagers and tadpoles. The time is an estimate: the server never sends an animal's real age, so the timer starts at the full 20:00 the first time a baby is seen — walk up to a half-grown calf and it reads too high. Feeding by other players is invisible for the same reason.
breedtimer.config.showReady.desc: Show animals and villagers that are ready to breed.
breedtimer.config.showCooldown.desc: Show animals and villagers that are still on their breeding cooldown.
breedtimer.config.showInLove.desc: Show animals that are currently in love mode.
breedtimer.config.showBlocked.desc: Show animals the game currently refuses to breed, and the reason why.
breedtimer.config.showDropWindows.desc: Off by default. Shows a narrowing time window for a chicken's next egg or an armadillo's next scute, once the mod has heard one drop. This is a guess, not a fact read from the game.
breedtimer.config.showBlocks.desc: Show labels for turtle eggs, sniffer eggs, dried ghasts and beehives.
breedtimer.config.showFoodHint.desc: Adds a second line under each animal label naming the items that feed it.
breedtimer.config.colorPreset.desc: Which colours the labels and the compact HUD use. "Colour-blind" is built for red–green colour vision deficiency, which is about 99% of all cases: it drops green and red entirely for a blue-and-amber set, and shows the in-love state in the same blue as ready. "High contrast" is a different problem — every colour is brightened until it stands out against a dark background, and the text outline is switched on so it survives snow and sand; it does not help with colour blindness. Whichever you pick, the ✓ ❤ 🔒 ✖ marks in front of a label say the same thing without any colour at all.
breedtimer.config.labelOpacity.desc: Opacity of the dark box behind a floating label. At 0.00 the box disappears entirely, which leaves bright text on bright terrain — turn Text outline on if you go that low.
breedtimer.config.textOutline.desc: Draw a dark outline around every letter of a floating label. Costs a little performance and changes the look, but keeps labels readable with the background box turned right down — and against snow or sand, where bright text otherwise disappears.
breedtimer.config.playSound.desc: Play a note-block pling the moment an animal or villager becomes ready. It fires once, only for one you can actually see at that moment.
breedtimer.config.soundVolume.desc: How loud the ready chime is. The switch above is what turns it off.
breedtimer.config.soundPitch.desc: Pitch of the ready chime. 1.00 is the note the mod has always played.
breedtimer.config.compactMode.desc: Replace the floating labels with one small panel that counts everything nearby by state. Toggled in game with B.
breedtimer.config.hudInViewOnly: Count only what is in view
breedtimer.config.hudInViewOnly.desc: Restores the old behaviour: the compact HUD counts only animals inside the view cone and fade range, instead of everything nearby.
breedtimer.config.hudOpacity.desc: Opacity of the compact HUD panel's background, set independently of the floating labels.
breedtimer.config.hudScale.desc: Size of the compact HUD panel. The HUD editor shows the panel at this scale, so a saved position stays where you put it.
breedtimer.config.hud_edit.desc: Opens the editor to freely place the HUD and manage presets.
